        org     30000

INIT    equ     25000
PLAY    equ     25006

        di
        ld      a,(#5D16)
        res     4,a
        ld      (DRIVE1+1),a
        set     4,a
        ld      (DRIVE2+1),a
        call    INIT
        ld      hl,#F300
        ld      de,#F301
        ld      c,l
        ld      b,e
        ld      a,h
        ld      (hl),#F4
        ldir
        ld      i,a
        im      2
        ld      hl,BARS
        ld      de,#F4F4
        ld      bc,END-BARS
        ldir
        ei
        ld      b,91            ; SECTORS
        ld      hl,0            ; START ADRESS
        push    hl
        ld      de,(#5CF4)      ; TRK/SEC
        call    DISK
        ld      (#5CF4),de      ; NEW TRK/SEC
        di
        im      0
        ei
        call    INIT
STOP    jr      STOP


BARS    ex      af,af'
        cp      b
Z1      jr      L1
        ld      (Z2+1),a
        ex      af,af'
        ei
        jp      #3D2F
L1      exx
        ld      a,1
        out     (254),a
        call    PLAY    ; SONG
        sub     a
        out     (254),a
L4      ld      a,0
        exx
        ld      a,h
        inc     a
        jr      nz,L3
        ld      a,l
        inc     a
        jr      nz,L3
        inc     sp
        inc     sp
L3      sub     a
        ld      (L4+1),a
        ex      af,af'
        ei
        jp      #3D2F
DISK    ld      a,#18
        ld      (Z1),a
        ld      a,d
        srl     a
        call    MOPS
        ld      a,#18
        call    MIXI
        call    MOPS1
FUCK    ld      a,d
        srl     a
        call    MIXI1
        bit     0,d
DRIVE1  ld      a,#2C
        jr      nz,DUST
DRIVE2  ld      a,#3C
DUST    call    MOPS2
FUCK2   ld      a,e
        inc     a
        call    MIXI2
AGAIN   push    hl
        ld      a,#84
        ld      c,1
        call    MIXI
        push    bc
        ld      bc,#7F
        ld      a,1
        ld      (Z2+1),a
        ld      a,#28
        ld      (Z1),a
        sub     a
        ex      af,af'
        call    MOPS1
        ex      af,af'
        push    bc
        ld      a,#18
        ld      (Z1),a
Z2      ld      a,1
        and     a
        call    z,BARS
        pop     bc
        ld      a,b
        pop     bc
        and     a
        jr      z,BACK
TURN    pop     hl
        jr      AGAIN
BACK    call    MIXI3
        and     8
        jr      z,SHIT
        ld      a,2
        ld      (L4+1),a
        jr      TURN
SHIT    pop     af
        ld      a,e
        add     a,c
        bit     4,a
        jr      z,MIXI4
        sub     a
        ld      e,a
        inc     d
        bit     0,d
        jr      nz,BACK2
        ld      a,#58
        call    MIXI
        call    MOPS1
BACK2   ld      a,b
        sub     c
        ld      b,a
        ret     z
        jp      FUCK
MIXI4   inc     e
        djnz    FUCK2
        ret
MIXI    push    hl
        ld      hl,#2FC3
        ex      (sp),hl
        jp      #3D2F
MIXI3   push    bc,hl
        ld      hl,FIKUS
        push    hl
        ld      hl,#3FEC
        push    hl
        ld      c,#1F
        ld      hl,#FFFE
        ei
        jp      #3D2F
FIKUS   dec     hl
        ld      a,(hl)
        pop     hl,bc
        ret
MIXI1   push    hl
        ld      hl,#1E3A
        ex      (sp),hl
        jp      #3D2F
MIXI2   push    bc
        ld      c,#5F
ZIRK    push    hl
        ld      hl,FIKUS2
        push    hl
        ld      hl,#2A53
        push    hl
        jp      #3D2F
FIKUS2  pop     hl,bc
        ret
MOPS    push    bc
        ld      c,#7F
        jr      ZIRK
MOPS2   push    hl
        ld      hl,#1FF3
        ex      (sp),hl
        jp      #3D2F
MOPS1   push    hl
        ld      hl,#3FE5
        ex      (sp),hl
        jp      #3D2F
END     ret
